title: Body at Rest
description: Fifteen minutes to let the body go and fall asleep. It doesn't end — it just drifts away.

segments.say: Lie down comfortably. Let your body sink into the mattress.
There's nothing left to solve today.
Let your eyes close, and your breath carry on by itself.
Feel the weight of your head on the pillow. Soften your face, your forehead, your jaw.
Let your shoulders sink. Feel your arms grow heavy, all the way to your fingertips.
Feel your chest rising and falling. Without changing anything.
Let your belly soften. Let your back release into the bed.
Let your hips grow heavy. Your legs. Your feet.
The whole body given over, heavy, held.
If your mind drifts to tomorrow, that's all right. Tomorrow isn't here yet.
Come back to the weight of your body.
Nothing to do. Nothing to wait for.
